description: Αποφάσεις Δημοτικής Επιχείρησης Ύδρευσης Αποχέτευσης Ηρακλείου (ΔΕΥΑΗ) is a dataset listed in data.gov.gr, a catalogue harvested into the European data portal, published or maintained by ΔΗΜΟΣ ΗΡΑΚΛΕΙΟΥ. All decisions of the company as posted on DIAVGEIA. Coverage: ΔΗΜΟΣ ΗΡΑΚΛΕΙΟΥ. The portal shows the English title as "Decisions of the Municipal Water Supply and Sewerage Company of Heraklion (DEYAI)" (machine-translated by the portal). The publisher named on the listing is ΔΗΜΟΣ ΗΡΑΚΛΕΙΟΥ. Its keywords include Νομικά Πρόσωπα. The listing shows 1 download or service links in XML. The listing shows 2026-02-21 as the last modification. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the portal listing (dataset page not read). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support water network and flood-defence studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-data-gov-gr.
